title: Interurban transporters block routes over unpaid bonus and promised public support
location: Several access routes to Tegucigalpa: north/CA-5, south and east approaches; exact per-site locations unresolved
organizer: Interurban transport sector representatives (specific organization not resolved)
threshold_50_evidence: Source uses “hundreds” for transporters across multiple access routes but gives no per-site distribution; cannot establish >=50 at any single gathering.

start_date.summary: Article date is Dec. 16 and body calls it Wednesday; 2020-12-16 was Wednesday.

location.summary: Several routes to capital; exact site-level blocks/counts are not distinguished.

demands.summary: Demands addressed to government and Honduran Land Transport Institute: bonus, preferential fuel price and promised BANHPROVI financing.

participants_original.summary: “Hundreds” aggregated across several routes; cannot assign to a single gathering.

notes: A contemporaneous body supports an executed multi-route strike and domestic state-policy target. Count is pooled geographically and should not be transferred to one site. Check prior transport stoppages and Jan 2021 continuity before episode ownership.
open_questions: What were the exact blocking sites and per-site crowds?
Did the action start before Dec. 16 or continue after it?
Is it a distinct episode from earlier 2020 transport stoppages?
